proposals.action_title: Launch First Amazon KDP Coloring Book in a High-Intent Micro-Niche
proposals.why_this_works_now: The 'produce_coloring_book' pipeline is ready. By spending under 5 EUR on Runware PAYG, Hugo can bypass GitHub Action IP bans and generate 40 ultra-clean FLUX-schnell vector-style coloring pages. KDP has no listing fees, providing immediate organic reach.
proposals.first_action_today: Deposit 5 EUR into Runware to get the API key, configure the KDP coloring book pipeline with a specific micro-niche (e.g., 'Cottagecore Animals' or 'Steampunk Vehicles'), and trigger the GitHub Action run.

proposals.action_title: Double-Dip: Sell the KDP Coloring Book Pages as a Digital PDF Bundle on Etsy
proposals.why_this_works_now: Etsy buyers actively search for printable PDF coloring books to print at home. Since the assets are already generated for the KDP book, packaging them as a single high-res PDF bundle costs nothing extra and targets a completely different audience.
proposals.first_action_today: Register an Etsy shop using a referral link (to get 40 free listings), combine the generated coloring book pages into one PDF using a Termux command-line tool (like pdftk or python-pdf), and create the listing.

proposals.action_title: Publish 5 Parametric OpenSCAD 3D Printing Models on Cults3D
proposals.why_this_works_now: Cults3D users love utility prints (cable organizers, custom brackets). Gemini can easily write flawless, highly customizable OpenSCAD (.scad) scripts. These scripts do not require complex 3D modeling software, meaning they can be generated entirely via Termux and run on GitHub Actions.
proposals.first_action_today: Use Gemini 2.5 Flash to generate 3 parametric utility designs (e.g., a modular honeycomb wall peg, an adjustable battery organizer), render preview images using OpenSCAD CLI in GitHub Actions, and list them on Cults3D for 1.99 EUR each.

proposals.action_title: Bulk Upload 50 Sticker Designs to Redbubble using Pollinations/TogetherAI
proposals.why_this_works_now: Redbubble is free to upload and handles printing, shipping, and customer service. By targeting highly specific, text-heavy, or simple illustration niches (such as coding inside jokes, local French regional humor, or specific hobbies), Hugo can capture long-tail organic search traffic.
proposals.first_action_today: Identify 5 specific niche communities on Reddit/Twitter, use the existing 'produce_svg_pack' or text-image pipeline to generate 50 transparent PNG sticker designs, and upload them to Redbubble from Termux/mobile browser.

proposals.action_title: Deploy a 2D Fantasy RPG Icon Asset Pack on itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Indie game developers constantly buy cheap UI and 2D item assets (potions, weapons, skill icons). Together AI's free tier (FLUX-schnell) can generate high-quality icon grids. Packaging these into a single zip with transparent backgrounds provides instant value with zero listing fees.
proposals.first_action_today: Run a image-generation prompt for '50 2D RPG Magic Potion Icons, flat vector, white background', use a simple Python script in Termux to batch-crop and remove backgrounds, and post the pack on itch.io for 2.99 USD.

proposals.action_title: Launch 10 Ultra-Targeted KDP Lined Notebooks with High-Impact AI Covers
proposals.why_this_works_now: Low-content lined journals require almost zero interior layout work (just a repeating lined page PDF). The single selling point is the cover. By using FLUX-schnell to generate striking, professional-grade artistic covers for specific professions or hobbies, Hugo can stand out immediately.
proposals.first_action_today: Create a reusable 120-page lined interior PDF using Python, generate 10 unique, niche-specific cover designs (e.g., 'Sourdough Baker's Logbook' or 'Beekeeper Journal') using Together AI, and upload them to KDP.
